lines.text: A crafted web request let an attacker run commands on Hex.pm's servers.
Hex.pm is where Elixir and Erlang programmers download code libraries.
lines.title: What is Hex.pm?

lines.text: The site unpacked data from strangers. A fake object in it caused an error.
lines.title: Step one

lines.text: Error logging then looked inside the object, and that ran code the attacker had chosen.
lines.title: Step two

lines.text: Hex.pm blocked the traffic and shipped a fix in about 20 minutes.
lines.title: Fast response

lines.text: No package changes were found, but data like email addresses and password hashes may have been read.
lines.title: Damage

lines.text: If you use Hex, change your password, reset 2FA and update your client.
lines.title: What to do
